topic: mobile tile padding and touch audio variants
currentUserGoal: User reports mobile tiles are still chopped and grass touch audio still sounds like one repeated SFX; fix both and deploy for phone testing.
changesMade: Increased compact mobile board content inset so early fields scale down slightly and keep more real space between grass tiles and the rounded board frame.
Expanded compact board mask bleed from a small edge allowance to a wider safe area so tile art and feedback are not cropped at the frame.
Replaced the single mobile fallback grass-touch WAV with seven generated lower crunchy scrape variants.
Expanded the mobile fallback audio pool to ten HTMLAudio players sourced from the seven variants and added slight playback-rate variation per touch.
